comparison: Incremental support snapshot expansion: same June metal prices, all 37 code inputs, other 80 data files, compositions, route steps, processing cost, LCA factors and profile weights. Only verified support observations are added. Economics and cost-weighted price-source confidence can both affect composite rankings.

source_contract.summary: paper_summary_<date>.json: weight_sensitivity, volatility, breakeven, live_reference_comparison, table62

replay.validation_note: An initial overly broad whole-file comparison included the three outputs with generated_at and failed. The actual replay contract uses exact bytes for seven stable JSON outputs and ignores only generated_at in the other three; no scientific field is excluded.

limitations: All support observations are US imports, world partner, six-digit HS all-grade unit values, not catalyst-grade supplier quotes.
The eight added support series contain June 2026 only; they are held at baseline in long historical replay and do not establish support-price volatility.
No missing observations, generic carbon/silica/zeolite LCA factors, manufacturing rates or catalyst performance measurements were invented.
Composite ranking changes reflect price changes and cost-weighted price-source confidence; they are not direct evidence of improved catalytic performance.
Original July paper artifacts and the previous one-series June supplement remain separate; this run is an additional support-price scenario.
